tap.about: A cushioned fingertip contact with a warm body; the default cursor tap.

click.about: A small mechanical press, a little firmer than tap, without a sharp top.

tick.about: A muted key contact; three equally calibrated timbres for fast typing.

toggle.about: Two restrained latch contacts, 38 ms apart, with a slight change in weight.

pop.about: A soft, hollow arrival with a felt attack, without a pitched droplet or blip.

swish.about: A short, quiet breath for camera/container travel >25% of the frame; never a UI change.

whoosh.about: Quiet, rounded air for camera/container travel >25% of the frame; never a UI change.

sparkle.about: A quiet glint of damped glass over air, without high bells or a glitter trail.

chime.about: A restrained warm-glass confirmation, two low notes with a brief soft tail.

ping.about: One short, centred, damped-glass notification; no stereo beating or shimmer.

riser.about: A gentle opening breath into a reveal, ending on the cue; no climbing synth.

hit.about: A low, cushioned settle for a landing; audible body without a long sub drop.
